subject: general
question:
**Directions :** Look at the underlined part of each sentence. Below each sentence, three possible situations for the underlined part are given. Indicate your responses accordingly. 

The passengers __have formed__ queue at the booking counter much before a train arrives.
solution:
The correct answer is:** form**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the sentence given, the underlined part must be substituted by *'form'.*
 
• The article '*a*' plays a major role in the above sentence as it determines this substitution.
 
• Here, the article '*a*' in the sentence not only mentions just one train but also every train that arrives.
 
• Thus,* 'have formed*' changes to* 'form*', since the tense changes to **simple present** to convey the general idea of people forming a queue.
 
• Also, since *'passengers'* is a plural noun, a plural verb follows it.
 
• Hence,** option 3 is correct.**

The correct sentence is__:** The passengers *form* queue at the booking counter much before a train arrives.**
